title: But he thought they were the portraits of the saints and great men of the order who were looking down on him silently as he passed:
html_source: It is interesting that Joyce describes the hallway to the rector’s as having many portraits of martyrs on the walls. Joyce seems to be hinting at a relation to Stephan and the martyrs. He may be suggesting that Stephan is a martyr in his own way because he is risking getting in trouble in able to protect the rights of him and his classmates. Martyrs are usually over-punished for their beliefs, just as Stephan was over-punished for not being able to do his work.

anchor.text: But he thought they were the portraits of the saints and great men of the order who were looking down on him silently as he passed:
anchor.prefix: of him and right and left through the gloom and thought that those must be portraits. It was dark and silent and his eyes were weak and tired with tears so that he could not see.
